### <a id="signoz-audit-action-category"></a>`signoz.audit.action_category`

Category of the audited operation.

- **Value Type:** string
- **Stability:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)
- **Examples:** `configuration_changes`

Values are audit event categories of IEC 62443-3-3 SR 2.8, lowercased
with words joined by underscores.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `access_control` | A change to who may do what, such as a role assignment or a credential change. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `configuration_changes` | A change to a metaresource or a platform setting, such as a dashboard or an alert rule change. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |

### <a id="signoz-audit-outcome"></a>`signoz.audit.outcome`

Outcome of the audited operation.

- **Value Type:** string
- **Stability:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)
- **Examples:** `success`

The set is complete.

An operation served over HTTP counts as a success when the response
status code is 2xx or 3xx. A failed operation also carries the upstream
`exception.*` attributes describing the failure.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `success` | The operation succeeded. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `failure` | The operation failed. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |

### <a id="signoz-audit-verb"></a>`signoz.audit.verb`

Operation the principal performed on the resource.

- **Value Type:** string
- **Stability:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)
- **Examples:** `update`

Known values: `create`, `update`, `delete`, `attach`, `detach`.

`attach` and `detach` relate two resources and are recorded once from
each side, with `signoz.resource.target.*` describing the other side.

## Events

### <a id="signoz-audit-attach"></a>`signoz.audit.attach`

Records the attachment of one SigNoz resource to another.

- **Stability:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)
- **Entities:** `signoz.resource`

Recorded twice per attachment, once from each side of the relation,
after the operation has completed. For `attach dashboard D to alert rule
R`, one record describes D with `signoz.resource.*` and R with
`signoz.resource.target.*`, and the other record swaps them. The
timestamp is the time of the operation.

Severity SHOULD be `INFO` (9) when `signoz.audit.outcome` is `success`
and `ERROR` (17) when it is `failure`.

**[1] `client.address`:** The address the request came from, without the port. The port is
`client.port`.

**[2] `exception.message`:** > [!WARNING]
> Exception messages may contain user-supplied data.

**[3] `exception.type`:** The class of the failure. Values are the error types the platform
raises: `invalid-input`, `not-found`, `already-exists`,
`unauthenticated`, `forbidden`, `unsupported`, `canceled`, `timeout`,
`license-unavailable`, `too-many-requests` and `internal`.

**[4] `signoz.principal.email`:** Set for user principals; service accounts have no email address.

> [!WARNING]
> This attribute contains personally identifiable information (PII).

**[5] `signoz.principal.id`:** The user or the service account that performed the operation.

**[6] `signoz.resource.id`:** Set to `*` when the operation applies to the collection of all
resources of the kind rather than to a single resource.

**[7] `signoz.workspace.key.id`:** The ingestion key the audited resource is or belongs to. When
`signoz.resource.kind` is `ingestion-key` the value equals
`signoz.resource.id`; it SHOULD also be set when the kind is
`ingestion-limit`.

**[8] `url.path`:** > [!WARNING]
> Path segments contain resource identifiers, including those of
> resources the principal was not allowed to reach.

### <a id="signoz-audit-create"></a>`signoz.audit.create`

Records the creation of a SigNoz resource.

- **Stability:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)
- **Entities:** `signoz.resource`

Recorded once per creation, after the operation has completed. The
timestamp is the time of the operation.

Severity SHOULD be `INFO` (9) when `signoz.audit.outcome` is `success`
and `ERROR` (17) when it is `failure`.

### <a id="signoz-audit-detach"></a>`signoz.audit.detach`

Records the detachment of one SigNoz resource from another.

- **Stability:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)
- **Entities:** `signoz.resource`

Recorded twice per detachment, once from each side of the relation,
after the operation has completed. For `detach dashboard D from alert
rule R`, one record describes D with `signoz.resource.*` and R with
`signoz.resource.target.*`, and the other record swaps them. The
timestamp is the time of the operation.

and `ERROR` (17) when it is `failure`.

`license-unavailable`, `too-many-requests` and `internal`.

**[5] `signoz.principal.id`:** The user or the service account that performed the operation.

**[6] `signoz.resource.id`:** Set to `*` when the operation applies to the collection of all
resources of the kind rather than to a single resource.

**[7] `signoz.workspace.key.id`:** The ingestion key the audited resource is or belongs to. When
`signoz.resource.kind` is `ingestion-key` the value equals
`signoz.resource.id`; it SHOULD also be set when the kind is
`ingestion-limit`.

**[8] `url.path`:** > [!WARNING]
> Path segments contain resource identifiers, including those of
> resources the principal was not allowed to reach.

### <a id="signoz-audit-update"></a>`signoz.audit.update`

Records the modification of a SigNoz resource.

- **Stability:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)
- **Entities:** `signoz.resource`

Recorded once per modification, after the operation has completed. The
timestamp is the time of the operation.

Severity SHOULD be `INFO` (9) when `signoz.audit.outcome` is `success`
and `ERROR` (17) when it is `failure`.
